content.page_summary: Reference list of clinical trials and meta-analyses addressing pharmacologic treatments for heart failure (predominantly heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and chronic heart failure). Entries include SGLT2 inhibitors, dapagliflozin, sotagliflozin, candesartan, ivabradine, vericiguat, and isosorbide dinitrate plus hydralazine among others.
